description: This Java source file defines the CommonServices class in the org.apache.ofbiz.common package. It provides a suite of static methods implementing various common services such as test services, note creation, debug level adjustment, entity and transaction testing, content and file handling, metrics management, and other utility functions for the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CommonServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for common OFBiz service operations including testing, entity management, debugging, and metrics.

methods.name: testService
methods.description: A simple service that logs and returns a success response, optionally logging input context entries.

methods.name: testSOAPService
methods.description: Creates dummy testing nodes and returns them as part of the response.

methods.name: blockingTestService
methods.description: Simulates a blocking service delay based on input duration.

methods.name: testRollbackListener
methods.description: Registers a rollback service for testing transaction rollback mechanisms.

methods.name: testCommitListener
methods.description: Registers a commit service for testing transaction commit.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a NoteData entity with provided details, including automatically generating the noteId.

methods.name: adjustDebugLevels
methods.description: Adjusts debugging levels dynamically based on input parameters.

methods.name: forceGc
methods.description: Invokes garbage collection explicitly.

methods.name: echoService
methods.description: Returns the input context as a success response.

methods.name: returnErrorService
methods.description: Returns an error message for testing error handling.

methods.name: conditionTrueService
methods.description: ECA condition service that returns true.

methods.name: conditionFalseService
methods.description: ECA condition service that returns false.

methods.name: entityFailTest
methods.description: Attempts to create an entity with invalid data to cause a referential integrity error.

methods.name: entitySortTest
methods.description: Tests sorting of ModelEntity objects retrieved from delegator.

methods.name: makeALotOfVisits
methods.description: Creates a specified number of Visit entities for testing.

methods.name: displayXaDebugInfo
methods.description: Displays transaction resource debug info if enabled.

methods.name: byteBufferTest
methods.description: Writes ByteBuffer data to files in the OFBiz home directory.

methods.name: uploadTest
methods.description: Handles file upload, creating data resource and content entries.

methods.name: mcaTest
methods.description: Logs details of a MimeMessage for testing message handling.

methods.name: streamTest
methods.description: Reads lines from an input stream and logs them, then writes back to an output stream.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Tests datasource connectivity and returns a message.

methods.name: getAllMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves current metrics information and returns as list.

methods.name: resetMetric
methods.description: Resets the specified metric by name.
